About

I am a self-taught MERN stack developer focused on building clean, efficient, and scalable web applications. I enjoy working on both frontend and backend systems.

My current focus is improving my skills in React, Node.js, and database design while building real-world projects that solve practical problems.

I aim to create applications that are simple to use, fast, and reliable, with a strong emphasis on code quality and structure.
